{{Top|leg}}
'''Corellian stingwasps''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] that lived in hives. The [[Livien Magnus spaceport|spaceport]] of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Livien Magnus]] on [[Ord Radama/Legends|Ord Radama]] looked similar to a Corellian stingwasp hive.<ref name="OAA1">''[[Onslaught at Arda I]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Corellian stingwasp was mentioned in ''[[Onslaught at Arda I]]'', a [[2014]] [[Star Wars Roleplaying|roleplaying]] adventure published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] for use with the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] [[roleplaying game]] system.<ref name="OAA1" />
